body:
SUSPECTED defect, not confirmed. Source: w4 batch lane, PR beamfall/corvint#789.

Observed: groupreap and testrunner tests fail under host load with 'owner token unreadable for pid N: invalid argument'. They pass in isolation and with -count=3. Expected: deterministic under load. Related umbrella: V1-0849.
